Title: Roof Repair Work Now Started
Description:
As some of you may have noticed work has now started on the repairs to the church roof. Scaffolding has gone up and the start of the actual repairs is imminent so please stay safe when in the churchyard by following the signs that have been placed near the entrances and any directions given by the workmen on site. During this period service locations have been changed as follows:

The Sunday 0945 service will take place at the usual time but in The Village Hall.
Other Sunday services will be held at Holy Trinity Church in Freckleton which is our sister church.
The Wednesday morning 0930 service will take place at the usual time but in The Vicarage on Church Road (opposite the entrance by Church Gardens).

Please keep checking the Church Noticeboard for any further updates.

Title: Update on St Pauls Church Roof: October 2019
Description:
You will hopefully have seen that the renovation project has started, the building has been scaffolded and the new roof slates are replacing the tired and worn ones!

We have recently reached our target with the help of some generous donations and a series of grants.

The following awarding bodies have contributed as follows:

The George and Maisie Blackburn Fund have awarded us £20,000

The Garfield Weston Foundation have awarded us £10,000

The National Churches Trust has also awarded us £10,000

These 3 awards bring the total amount of grants awarded for the roof restoration to £48,450.

This funding, which when combined with monies from the sale of some long-term investments and the money we have fundraised, has allowed us to instruct a specialist roofing company to commence work. We expect that the work will be completed in early 2020.

Look out for further updates when it is nearing completion!

Ian Fraser, Church Warden

Title: St Paul's Now Open For Worship
Description:
In line with Government guidance, St Paul's Church re-opened for Sunday Worship on 5th July 2020. The service is a little bit different from before Coronavirus struck in that there is no singing allowed and that no wine is taken at Communion. No hugs or handshakes are allowed during the Peace which instead consists of verbal responses said to each other and waves across the pews.
From 8th August, face coverings are now compulsory inside church.
The Wednesday morning service has now also restarted in church.

Title: Our New Vicar
Description:
The PCC of St Paul's Church, Warton are pleased to make the following announcement:
Rev'd Tracy Swindells has been appointed as the new Vicar for Warton and Freckleton.  Currently Vicar of Langho in the Ribble Valley, Rev'd Tracy is expected to join us formally in the early summer.
This is great news and I hope you can all help in  welcoming Rev'd Tracy when she arrives.

**************** Update ***********************
Following her installation service on Sunday 4th June we are pleased to announce that Rev. Tracy Swindells is now in post as the Vicar of the Joint Benefice of St Paul's Warton and Holy Trinity Freckleton.

Title: SAFEGUARDING
Description: The parish of Warton: St Paul is committed to the safeguarding of children, young people and adults. We follow the House of Bishops guidance and policies and have our own Parish Safeguarding Officer(s), PSOs. The Diocese of Blackburn’s safeguarding pages contain vital links and information including contacts for the Diocesan Safeguarding Advisor (DSA) who advise our PSOs. If you are concerned that a child or adult has been harmed or may be at risk of harm please contact the DSA. If you have immediate concerns about the safety of someone, please contact the police and your local authority Children or Adults Services.
